llm_top3.reasoning: JAZZ combines the top quantitative rank with a genuinely material catalyst: a first-line FDA approval that pushed shares to record highs and triggered a broad wave of price-target raises toward $300+, with a fresh launch ahead. TTWO has a high-materiality, near-dated catalyst in the well-received extended GTA VI preview and a November launch that analysts say could set records. I deviate from rank-2 DBX and rank-3 ADBE: DBX's news read is actually negative (flat revenue, margin compression, Bear of the Day, repeated insider selling) despite its accumulation signal, and ADBE's move is sector-sentiment rather than company-specific. I substitute BKR, which has concrete order momentum (76 NovaLT16 turbines, ~1.3GW for data centers), book-to-bill above 2:1, and an RBC target raise, giving it real AI-power exposure with contracted backlog.

JAZZ.reasoning: FDA approval of two first-line Ziihera regimens in HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma drove record highs and a wave of analyst price-target raises to $281-$322, partly offset by a $1B exchangeable notes offering.

DBX.reasoning: Bullish technical breakout to 52-week highs and $900M buyback are offset by flat ~1% revenue growth, margin compression, Zacks Bear of the Day, and multiple executive share sales.

ADBE.reasoning: Broad software/SaaS re-rating with ADBE surging to highest levels since February on 'software is not dead' AI sentiment, though no company-specific catalyst ahead of earnings.

NWSA.reasoning: New 1-year high on an 8-day winning streak, $1B buyback, and Fox re-merger chatter, tempered by Trump's revived $10B defamation suit against News Corp.

BRK-B.reasoning: Mostly commentary on Buffett/Abel transition, cash pile criticism and Google stake; nothing materially new.

BSY.reasoning: New CRO appointment and Japan digital-twin project participation with several undervaluation notes, but also tariff-driven software weakness and lingering margin doubts.

CME.reasoning: Steady product-expansion news (single-stock futures distribution, E-mini equity factor futures, wind power and zinc contracts) is incrementally positive but low-impact, with prediction-market disruption as a mild overhang.

C.reasoning: Headlines are mostly Citi research on other companies plus routine 13F filings; SEC subpoenas of Wall Street banks over an AI hedge fund are a mild negative.

EVRG.reasoning: Q2 EPS up 26% with guidance reaffirmed and 3 GW of data-center load signed, but headlines are dominated by routine 13F filings and bearish chart updates below the 10 DMA.

SW.reasoning: Q2 EBITDA miss on freight/energy costs and lowered FY guidance offset by Morgan Stanley naming it top pick with a $58 target and containerboard price hikes.

AIG.reasoning: Q2 beat on EPS and revenue with dividend appeal, but RBC-driven concern that management will hoard cash rather than return it leaves the stock rangebound.

SLB.reasoning: Venezuela data contract and Norwegian carbon-storage award are positives, but oil fell over 4%, CEO sold 25,000 shares, and the stock has been declining against a rising market.

DV.reasoning: Being acquired by Nielsen at a fixed $13.60/share cash makes further news largely immaterial despite the Q2 revenue miss and an upgrade.

MTG.reasoning: Zacks upgrade to Strong Buy, best value/income lists, and target raise to ~$29.79, though Q2 revenue fell ~3% and headlines are mostly routine director dividend-unit filings.

TTWO.reasoning: Extended GTA VI gameplay preview on Netflix drove shares up and analysts flagged 'blockbuster demand' and record launch potential.

TOST.reasoning: Strong 23% revenue growth and a 7-day winning streak clash with a 5% drop on a $10K SMB bonus program raising pricing/competition concerns and profit-taking.

ADT.reasoning: Raised FY26 free cash flow outlook and cheap valuation are offset by weak recurring customer base, a neutral BTIG initiation, and competitive threat from Amazon's Ring.

BAC.reasoning: Elliott-wave and technical commentary point to further downside toward $57-59, shares fell 1.7%, and SEC subpoenas over hedge-fund leverage add uncertainty.

BKR.reasoning: RBC raised its target to $76, book-to-bill above 2:1, and a large 76-unit NovaLT16 turbine order (~1.3GW) for data centers positions it as an AI-power winner.

MPC.reasoning: Refining momentum with new 52-week highs, strong margins, Barron's seeing more upside and multiple value-stock screens, though some see it as modestly overvalued now.

IRT.reasoning: Q2 FFO beat with guidance affirmed, a 6% dividend hike and a rating upgrade, though GAAP EPS collapsed and a large holder trimmed its stake.

INVH.reasoning: Q2 FFO and revenue beat with FY26 core FFO guidance raised and JPMorgan lifting its target to $34, offset by chatter about PE landlords selling houses.

TTD.reasoning: Stock at 8-year lows with heavy short interest, S&P 500 exclusion fears, huge deep-ITM put positioning and a 24% monthly drop despite the Kokai Zuma launch.

GME.reasoning: 52-week low, Michael Burry dumping his stake, criticism of the failed $56B eBay bid, and a $1.4B dilutive debt-for-stock exchange.

OMC.reasoning: Q2 revenue up 63% on the Interpublic deal with undervaluation arguments, but persistent skepticism that AI erodes the agency model and the stock trades lower on integration strain.

GM.reasoning: Deep-value case at 8.2x forward earnings and a good 2027 setup collide with Trump's 50% Canada auto tariff threat, a 4.2% sales decline, and a 1.1M-vehicle brake probe.

KIM.reasoning: Record occupancy, raised FY26 FFO outlook and a 12% dividend increase, tempered by a JPMorgan Neutral rating and $600M notes issuance.

GE.reasoning: LEAP deliveries up 41% and a golden cross are offset by a 3.4% drop, ~12% pullback from August highs, margin/supply-chain concerns and full-valuation commentary.

ROKU.reasoning: Shares sit near the ~$164 Fox buyout value at 52-week highs, so upside is capped and JPMorgan assumed coverage at Neutral on deal arbitrage.

SGI.reasoning: CEO bought $1.89M of stock on the open market and the Leggett & Platt merger cleared EU approval and shareholder vote with an S&P upgrade to BB+, despite Q2 sales declining 3%.
